N = int(input())
cnt = [0] * 26
move = 0
str_input = list(input())
b_str = input().split()
b = list(map(int, b_str))
res = sum(b)
N_half = N // 2

for i in range(N_half):
    if str_input[i] == str_input[N - i - 1]:
        index = ord(str_input[i]) - ord('a')
        cnt[index] += 1
        move += 1
        res -= min(b[i], b[N - i - 1])

for i in range(26):
    if cnt[i] > move / 2:
        left = cnt[i] * 2 - move
        pos = []
        for j in range(N_half):
            if str_input[j] != str_input[N - j - 1]:
                if (ord(str_input[N - j - 1]) - ord('a') == i) or (ord(str_input[j]) - ord('a') == i):
                    continue
                else:
                    pos.append(min(b[j], b[N - j - 1]))
        pos.sort()
        for j in range(min(left, len(pos))):
            res -= pos[j]

print(res)
